what: The Supervisor of Elections’ 1995 declaration (Gazette No. 36, 30 June 1995) disagrees with the PEO compilation for 3 winners: Town of St. George, Fletcher 855 vs 791; St. George South, Isaac 1,350 vs 1,349; St. Andrew SW, Baptiste 940 vs 935. The notice mentions a recount in one constituency. The Grenada Newsletter ended in 1994, so there is no independent check.
action: Both figures shown (✱✱). Ask the PEO for the certified 1995 statements of poll.
